decisions.state_note: o000: Window around x105–168,y117–180 shows dark upper area and an upright dark band near x149 extending through lower crop; light lies on both sides below. Digit uncertain.

o001: Visible x105–168,y85–148 has a dark diagonal rising right from the left edge into a broad upright region near x145–161; a narrower dark extension reaches the top edge near x140. Detector supports the diagonal. Upper structure remains cropped.

o002: Window x105–168,y53–116 shows a dark curved upper/right band around a light region at x105–132,y74–111; dark thickens toward bottom right. Detector identifies an upright segment near (140,85). Left side and top are cropped; a loop is not established.

o003: Window x73–136,y53–116 shows a thick dark band rising right from near (76,90) toward (106,59), with light above-left and a broad light region below-right. No detector instances. Left/lower continuation remains unknown; an upper loop is a hypothesis.

o004: Window x73–136,y85–148 shows a light recess above a broad dark band across y118–139, rising toward the right; dark also borders the recess on the left. Detector reports horizontal and rising-right bands. Upper-loop hypothesis remains plausible; lower structure is unknown.
o005: Window x73–136,y117–180 shows a dark band along the top, with a scalloped lower contour around y130–144 and light below. No detector instances. Lower-right continuation needs inspection.

o006: Window x105–168,y117–180 shows a dark band across the top feeding a near-upright right band around x143–163 down to the bottom crop, with light on both sides. Detector supports upright segment near (149,159). Lower termination remains unseen.

o007: Window x105–168,y149–212 shows a thick slightly left-leaning shaft ending in a rounded cap near (141,209), with visible light below. Detector agrees. Upper shape could distinguish 9 from 4; closure remains unverified.

o008: Revisited x105–168,y117–180; dark upper band meets an upright right shaft, with light on both sides below. Detector supports shaft near (149,159). Upper closure still needs inspection to distinguish 9 from 4.

o009: Window x105–168,y85–148 shows a rising-right dark band joining a broad right shaft, plus a narrow dark extension through the top near x140. Detector supports the diagonal; upper closure remains uncertain.

o010: Revisited x105–168,y53–116; curved dark band borders light on its left and joins broader dark area below-right. Detector marks upright segment near (140,85). Top contour is cropped; moving above it may resolve upper closure.

o011: Window x105–168,y21–84 shows a rounded dark upper contour near y46–49 turning downward on the right toward x147, with a light recess below-left. Detector marks a short horizontal band near (117,60). This supports a 9 hypothesis; upper-left continuation remains cropped.

o012: Window x73–136,y21–84 shows a thick upper band rising right to a rounded top near y46, with light above and below-right; detector supports horizontal and rising-right portions. Together with the previously observed left/bottom bands and descending right shaft, this supports digit 9.
